worker_configuration: unchanged OM defaults, same session model
observation_pack: upstream defaults: >10 KiB; 2 full sends; 1 KiB placeholder
cost: Pi configured prices and OpenAI Standard API equivalent; neither is a verified invoice
analysis_rules: Exclude provider or harness failures from quality/cost comparisons; retain logs
Report worker usage and actual cache-read tokens
No statistically reliable superiority claim from a single task and repetition

selection_note: Cython reference solution failed 1 of 11 checks; excluded before any successful model trial. OpenAI OAuth endpoint reset connections; existing Pi Luna provider succeeds.
harness_calibration: Initial four Bottle pilot runs used a CLI tool allowlist that omitted extension tools. Excluded. Final runs explicitly allow and assert update_plan, recall, and obs_recall where applicable.
repeat_reason: One baseline Reflector response returned HTTP 503; repeat all arms once to expose run variance. Both attempts retained in analysis.
additional_control: Add two original OM runs without update_plan/tool-guidelines to measure planning overhead. Matched-plan baseline remains for mechanism ablations. Added after first four valid attempts, before observing original-control outcomes.
concurrency_note: Initial ablations used two concurrent trials. After 429/503 interruptions, original controls and replacements run serially; this is a confound and is disclosed.
